title: Experimental Systems Engineer
snippet:
At nT-Tao, we are building a compact magnetic confinement fusion power system: a modular, repeatable unit designed to deliver clean electricity on-site, on- or off-grid. Getting there means solving hard, open problems in plasma physics, and that is the work our physicist's lead.
Founded in 2019, nT-Tao raised $34 million to date from Honda, East X Ventures, Delek US, NextGear Ventures, and others. The Israel Innovation Authority has awarded us repeated grants, most recently to build our next compact fusion demonstrator.
Position Overview
We are looking for a hands-on Experimental Systems Engineer to take ownership of our experimental fusion prototypes, laboratory infrastructure, and supporting systems.
The role combines experimental operations, multidisciplinary system integration, troubleshooting, maintenance, and continuous improvement.
You will be responsible for ensuring that the experimental platform is operational, reliable, and ready to support the company's R&D activities.
Key Responsibilities
Take ownership of the day-to-day operation, readiness, maintenance, and reliability of experimental fusion prototypes and supporting laboratory infrastructure.
Plan, prepare, and conduct experimental campaigns in close collaboration with the physics and engineering teams.
Operate and monitor multidisciplinary systems, including pulsed-power generators, magnetic systems, vacuum systems, cooling systems, RF/microwave equipment, diagnostics, and control systems.
Configure experimental setups, integrate new hardware, and support prototype upgrades and commissioning.
Operate data acquisition and control systems, collect experimental measurements, and ensure data quality, traceability, and proper documentation.
Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, electronic, and control-system malfunctions, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
Develop and maintain experimental procedures, operating protocols, maintenance plans, and safety procedures.
Improve

שירות ופתרון תקלות — אבחון תקלות חשמל ובקרה, תחזוקה ותמיכה במערכות שהותקנו.
עבודה משותפת עם צוות ההרכבה המכנית ומהנדסי המערכת — תיאום הביצוע, מתן משוב על שרטוטים והצעת שיפורים.

ניסיון באפיון ובתכנון ארונות חשמל ובקרה.

The Electrical Supervisor will inspect installations and repairs, troubleshoot electrical faults, and verify compliance with safety standards and applicable regulations. The role also involves coordinating with project managers and other departments, maintaining documentation of maintenance and inspection activities, and supporting continuous improvement in electrical reliability and efficiency.

Candidates should possess strong Supervisory Skills, including team leadership, task planning, and performance monitoring.
Candidates should possess practical expertise in Electrical Maintenance and Electricity, with experience in troubleshooting and repairing electrical systems.
Candidates should possess solid knowledge of Electrical Engineering principles relevant to industrial or commercial environments.
